items.title: China exports, imports soar past expectations in October — surplus narrows sharply
items.body: Goods exports soared by 35.2% last month from a year earlier, exceeding expectations for a 33.5% jump in a Reuters poll and slowing from a 36.3% jump in September.

items.title: 3 unexpected reasons the October jobs report was so strong
items.body: October's jobs report blew past economist forecasts. Here are three reasons.

items.title: A key report for where inflation stood in October comes out Tuesday. Here's what to expect
items.body: The CPI headline reading is expected to show an increase of 0.3% while the core is forecast to increase 0.2%.

items.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
items.body: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.

items.title: A disturbing employment trend is hiding beneath the latest strong job numbers
items.body: The average jobless worker's bout of unemployment surpassed 27 weeks in October, the highest outside of the pandemic period in a decade.

items.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate slips to 4.1%
items.body: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate was expected to hold steady at 4.2%.

items.title: The October jobs report is out Friday. Here's everything to expect
items.body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases the October nonfarm payrolls report Friday at 8:30 a.m. ET.

items.title: Voters say the economy drove them to the polls — and blame Trump for their troubles
items.body: Participants in the CNBC Voter Poll ranked the economy the most important issue facing the country, ahead of topics tied to democracy and immigration.
